title: Imide-based covalent organic frameworks: molecular design, synthesis, and applications in clean energy and environmental remediation

Imide-based covalent organic frameworks (Imide-COFs) have emerged as a chemically robust subclass of COFs, distinguished by their π-conjugated backbones, high crystallinity, and structural tunability.
